name: Gooey Nav
description: Segmented tab navigation with dynamic organic bezier neck stretching and corner radius morphing.
summary: An organic navigation bar engineered with harmonic spring physics and dynamic SVG quadratic bezier neck interpolation. When switching active tabs, adjacent segments fluidly separate with an elastic connecting meniscus that pinches, stretches, and snaps across tabs, while border radii dynamically morph between fused and detached states.
highlights: Dynamic SVG quadratic bezier neck with a waist that thins by a 1.4 power curve as the gap grows
Simultaneous spring-driven corner radius morphing between fused (0px) and detached (corner) states
Keyboard selection with ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Home and End
Two spring presets: fluid and elastic
Multiple visual variants including solid elevated surface, vibrant aura glow, and frosted glass
Independent active color palettes with matching linear gradients spanning the seam gaps
anatomy: <nav> (Wrapper) containing <ul role="tablist"> with the keyboard handler
<Segment> (Spring-positioned segment with dynamic margin-left and corner radius morphing)
<svg> (Connecting seam bridge rendering the dynamic bezier neck path)
<linearGradient> (Dynamic two-stop color transition bridging neighboring tiles)
<NavLabel> (Interactive tab link or button with ARIA attributes and active styling)

physics.engine: Motion Spring Dynamics & Quadratic Bezier Geometry
physics.description: Damped harmonic oscillator governing seam separation distances coupled with mathematical waist thinning at NECK_BREAK = 0.44.

accessibility.aria: Standard role='tablist' on container, role='tab' on buttons, aria-selected for active state, and proper tabIndex handling.
accessibility.reducedMotion: useReducedMotion fallback jumps positions instantly with zero duration.

keyboard.description: Moves focus into the tablist (active tab only).
Selects the next tab, wrapping from last to first.
Selects the previous tab, wrapping from first to last.
Activates the focused tab (button click or link navigation).

recommended: Primary application navigation bars and section tab switchers
Dashboard sub-navigation and workspace segmented controls
bestPractices: Keep tab count between 3 and 7 for optimal horizontal stretching ergonomics
Use distinct icons alongside labels for improved scannability
Choose high-contrast active colors against dark backgrounds

props.name: items
props.description: Array of tab navigation items as strings or objects with label, icon, and optional href.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback triggered when the active tab index changes.

props.name: size
props.description: Size preset governing padding, typography, icon size, and separation distance.

props.name: activeLabelColor
props.description: Custom active label text color override.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual appearance style: solid elevated tiles, ambient glow, or frosted glass.

props.name: elasticity
props.description: Spring dynamics preset governing transition stiffness and damping.

props.name: separation
props.description: Custom gap distance in pixels between separated segments.

props.name: radius
props.description: Custom corner border radius in pixels.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes passed to the outer nav element.
